# ASHU Electrical Solution

## Overview
ASHU Electrical Solution is an electrical contractor and technical service provider in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. The company supports office renovation, fit-out, electrical installation, power systems, maintenance, and project execution services for commercial, industrial, and institutional clients.
